native-experience → \"Adaptive layout\".reason: reader-theming's block is already a subset of one-library-three-destinations', which adds two scenarios about reaching destinations and a window too small for a layout. Nothing needed merging; the order is recorded because no tool can infer it and syncing one-library first would leave reader-theming's later sync deleting those two scenarios.

settings-and-about → \"Appearance\".reason: close-the-audited-gaps' block is reader-theming's Natural-theme block carried whole, plus one new scenario, 'Choosing the linked pair', that decision D15 adds: two pickers under the opt-in link that choose which reading theme stands for light and which for dark. Nothing needed merging on the shared scenarios; the order is recorded because no tool can infer it and syncing close-the-audited-gaps first, then reader-theming second with its narrower block, would delete the picker scenario on that later sync.

ebook-reader → \"Reflowable rendering\".reason: close-the-audited-gaps' block carries reader-theming's whole block (its own reworded Typography-controls sentence included) and adds one scenario, 'Typeface, weight and margins apply under publisher styles', plus one clause on 'An axis is inert while publisher styles are on', both from decision D16. The order is recorded because no tool can infer it and syncing close-the-audited-gaps first, then reader-theming second with its narrower block, would delete the D16 scenario and clause on that later sync.

Default view: each shows its source only when more than one source is configured
Scoping to one source: the view, its search, and its filters apply to that source alone

Unified library.reason: Both are reversed on purpose, and the delta says the opposite in the same scenario. The shelf used to name a publication's source when more than one was configured; this change's whole premise is one library, so nothing on the shelf states which source a publication came from. And scoping is replaced by filtering: the delta says in as many words that a source is offered 'as a filter … and not as a scope the view is in', which is why 'the scope persists until changed' cannot be carried - there is no scope left to persist. Drains when one-library-three-destinations syncs.

Mixed local and server search: server results and local results are merged into one ranked list, each labelled with its source

Search.reason: Superseded by a more precise clause in the same scenario rather than dropped. The delta keeps the merging and refines the labelling: each result names the library that supplied it 'but only where more than one place could have answered', because where only one place could answer every row would carry the same words. Carrying the old sentence beside the new one would publish two rules for the same label. Drains when one-library-three-destinations syncs.

Adding the first source: offers to open a local file or folder without configuring anything, so the app is usable in under ten seconds

Source registry.reason: Rewritten longer, not removed. The delta replaces one sentence with five that say what the first screen shows, what the primary and secondary actions do, where the four source types are named and where they are not. The 'under ten seconds' figure goes with it: it was a target rather than an observable behaviour, and every requirement here is meant to be user-observable. Drains when one-library-three-destinations syncs.

Screen change: a screenshot from a booted simulator or emulator is captured at the project's device matrix and compared against the reference

shalls: Every change a user can see SHALL be verified against a running app on a real simulator or emulator, not against a preview.
Visual proof of interface changes.reason: Replaced on purpose by the owner's decision of 2026-10-09: frames cost hours per wave. Proof now comes from the builder looking at its own screen, snapshot tests (on the JVM for Android, so not always an emulator), machine accessibility checks, and a device screenshot only where a snapshot cannot draw the screen. The new 'Screen change' and 'A device screenshot where only a device shows it' scenarios carry what remains of both sentences. Drains when lighter-visual-check syncs.
